# Images Directory

Place your images in this directory structure:

## Required Images:

### Profile
- `avatar.jpg` - Your profile picture (recommended: 400x400px)

### Projects
Place project screenshots in `projects/` folder:
- `ecommerce.jpg`
- `taskapp.jpg`
- `chat.jpg`
- `weather.jpg`
- `cms.jpg`
- `fitness.jpg`

Recommended size: 600x400px or 1200x800px

### Testimonials (Optional)
Place testimonial profile pictures in `testimonials/` folder:
- `person1.jpg`
- `person2.jpg`
- `person3.jpg`

Recommended size: 100x100px

### Resume
- `resume.pdf` - Your resume file

## Tips:
- Use optimized images (compressed JPG or WebP)
- Keep file sizes under 500KB for better performance
- Use descriptive filenames
- Images will use fallback placeholders if not found
